questions.stem: At a high level, how does I Am Datapedia! distinguish Data Science from Artificial Intelligence?
options: Data Science is when humans build and run models; AI is when matured models are passed to machines to run themselves
Data Science uses structured data only; AI uses unstructured data only
Data Science is a branch of AI concerned with storing data
AI is any statistical model, while Data Science is any visualisation
There is no difference; the two terms are synonyms
questions.explanation: When models are created and run by humans it is called Data Science; when matured models are handed to systems or machines to run, train, fix, analyse and predict by themselves, it becomes AI.

questions.stem: Which kinds of data are used to create Data Science models in the current era?
options: Only structured data held in relational tables
Only unstructured data such as text and images
Only semi-structured data such as JSON files
Structured, semi-structured and unstructured data
Only data that has already been summarised
questions.explanation: Data Science models are created to analyse and predict on huge datasets, whether structured, semi-structured or unstructured.

questions.stem: Which of the following is NOT one of the things a matured model does by itself once it has become AI?
options: Train itself
Fix itself
Analyse itself
Predict itself
Recruit the data scientists who built it
questions.explanation: AI is described as a model that runs itself, trains itself, fixes itself, analyses itself and predicts itself; recruiting people is not part of that description.

questions.stem: A team of analysts builds a model on customer data and runs it themselves to predict which customers will leave. Which term best describes this activity?
options: Artificial Intelligence
Data Science
Data Entry
Machine Autonomy
Data Liberalisation
questions.explanation: When models are created and run by humans to analyse and predict, the activity is Data Science; it only becomes AI once the matured model runs itself on a machine.

questions.stem: At what point does a Data Science model become Artificial Intelligence?
options: As soon as it is written in a programming language
When it is trained on more than one million rows
When the matured model is passed to systems or machines that run, train, fix, analyse and predict by themselves
When a human approves its first prediction
When it is published in a dashboard for business users
questions.explanation: The dividing line is maturity plus autonomy: once the model is handed over to machines to run itself, it becomes AI.

questions.stem: What is the stated aim of comparing AI with Data Science in I Am Datapedia!?
options: To explain the difference between the two at a very high level
To elaborate in detail what AI is
To prove that AI will replace Data Science
To list every algorithm used in AI
To recommend a programming language for AI
questions.explanation: The author states the aim is not to explain AI in detail but to explain the difference between AI and Data Science at a very high level.

questions.stem: According to I Am Datapedia!, being clear about which subject makes understanding AI unproblematic?
options: Database administration
Data visualisation
Network security
Data Science
Project management
questions.explanation: The author says that if you are clear about Data Science, then understanding AI will not be a problem.

questions.stem: What are Data Science models created to do with huge datasets?
options: Archive and compress them
Analyse and predict
Encrypt and secure them
Rename and relocate them
Print and distribute them
questions.explanation: In the current era, Data Science models are created on huge datasets in order to analyse and predict.

questions.stem: How does I Am Datapedia! characterise the debate over AI versus Data Science?
options: A settled matter with a single accepted definition
A purely academic question with no practical relevance
A topic only relevant to hardware engineers
A question that only matters for unstructured data
A very controversial topic that confuses many people
questions.explanation: The author notes that people are confused between AI and Data Science and calls it a very controversial topic.

questions.stem: Which statement about Artificial Intelligence is consistent with the description in I Am Datapedia!?
options: AI is fully explained by the idea of a self-running model
AI is limited to models that predict customer behaviour
AI is much more than a self-running model, but the self-running model is the high-level distinction from Data Science
AI can only be built on structured data
AI is always created without any human involvement
questions.explanation: The author acknowledges that AI is much more than a matured model running itself, but uses that idea to explain the difference from Data Science at a high level.
